slides.headline: You stopped texting first. 4 days. The chat died.
slides.notes: Instant recognizable scene of the silence test; readable under 2 sec

slides.headline: The pain isn't silence, it's who carried it
slides.body: All along, this bond existed purely on your fuel. The second you let go of the wheel, the car simply stopped moving.
slides.animal_metaphor: faithful waiting by the silent screen

slides.headline: The trap: «Maybe he's just really busy?»
slides.body: You make excuses and itch to reach out again. But being busy is never four whole days without a single syllable.
slides.animal_metaphor: stubborn loyalty to an unasked question
slides.notes: The illusion of waiting and self-rationalization

slides.headline: He doesn't dislike you. He's a passenger
slides.body: He is happy to ride along as long as you buy the gas and drive. But he won't take a single step to make things happen.
slides.animal_metaphor: cold feline autonomy cuts through false hope

slides.headline: Replying vs Initiating: The honest test
slides.body:
«Replies to texts» → Polite passivity.
«Sends random memes» → Bored in line.
«Asks to see you» → He actually wants you.

slides.headline: 3 signs your chat is on life support
slides.body:
1. Without your prompt, the chat freezes for days.
2. Future plans are always «sometime soon».
3. His warmth only exists in your questions.

slides.headline: Never remind someone who's fine without you
slides.body: He is perfectly at ease without hearing your voice. Take your energy back to where it builds your life, not his comfort.
slides.notes: Rule to break the waiting loop

slides.headline: True reciprocity doesn't need CPR
slides.body: If a bond only survives when you keep pumping air into it, it's not a relationship. It's a monologue at a closed door.
slides.animal_metaphor: wisdom of letting go of illusions

slides.headline: Comment MIRROR
slides.notes: CTA: trigger MIRROR leads to Essence–Shadow–Vector audio reading in the app
